newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria sells 100,000 tonnes of wheat to Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Syria sells 100,000 tonnes of wheat to Algeria.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has sold Algeria 100,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for delivery between September and October, a GECPT official said on Monday.
He told Reuters the wheat was sold through negotiations between officials of the state-owned grains bodies of Syria and Algeria.
He did not reveal the price.
Syria last month sold Algeria 150,000 tonnes of durum wheat for delivery between August and September.
Traders said earlier this month that Algeria was negotiating for a further 150,000 tonnes of optional-origin durum wheat for September and October.
